lines.t: I've been running from the mirror
Blaming ghosts for every scar
Every shadow from my childhood
Still pretending it's who we are
I've been hiding in the silence
Calling brokenness my shield
Terrified of what you tell me
If I let my heart be healed
But in the quiet, something's calling
Like a whisper through the dark
You're tracing all the lines I'm covering
Reading secrets in my heart
So take these wounds, take these lies
Every story I've revised
All the ways I've learned to fall apart
I bring the hurt, I bring the blame
Every sin that wears my name
Lay it down and meet you where I am
You see it all and still you stay
You're the truth that doesn't look away
I can feel the old defenses
Like a tremor in my bones
Every vow I made in anger
Every wall I called my home
I've been living like a victim
But my hands aren't clean at all
I've been pointing at the ones who hurt me
Just to drown out your call
Yet in the ruins you are waiting
Not ashamed of what you see
Every fracture is an open door
Where your mercy reaches me
So take these wounds, take these lies
Every story I've revised
All the ways I've learned to fall apart
I'll bring the hurt and I'll bring the blame
Every sin that wears my name Lay it down and meet You where I am
See it all and still You stay You're the truth that doesn't look away
If I fall, let it be into your hands
Every hit of thought you understand
I'm done choosing one half of the truth
Heal the child and cleanse the man I go
So take these wounds, take these lies
Every story I've revised
All the pieces scattered in the dark
I'll bring the hurt, I'll bring the blame
Every sin that wears my name
Let your fire and kindness mark my heart
You see, oh, and still you stay
They hold my ruin, lead me into grace
Oh, the truth that doesn't look away
Oh, you're the fruit that doesn't look away
You're the truth that doesn't look away
Oh, you're the truth that doesn't look away
Oh, you're the truth that doesn't look away
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
